title: BIOLOG UTC instant
description: ADR-0001 Decision 2. RFC 3339 UTC with literal Z and exactly three fractional digits. No offsets, no naive values. Every field named *_at uses this. Calendar-validated: The day must exist in that month of that year: 2026-02-30 and 2026-02-29 are rejected, 2028-02-29 and 2000-02-29 are accepted, 1900-02-29 is not. Proleptic Gregorian leap rule. Mirrors contracts/js/clock.mjs exactly. Year range 1000-9999 inclusive: the intersection of the MySQL DATE/DATETIME supported range and .NET DateTime, so every surface can store and round-trip it. Year 0000 is out of range in both the schema and contracts/js/clock.mjs.
